critique: The cascading red, bone, ochre, and cedar-green sand over pulsing ovoids creates a bold cyber-organic field, while the formline flamingo and tiny dune-hidden guinea pig add genuine surprise and playfulness. The concentric arcs, U-forms, grain, seam washes, and foreground simulation compete at similar intensity; selectively clearing space around the flamingo’s neck and the central sand streams would sharpen the hierarchy and let the transformation motif read more decisively.
